note: Search Basic is billed per hour while it exists. The 'indexed' screen is a split screen: terminal (recorded here) plus the portal index page (see 'also').
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-3 -l swedencentral -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-3 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 600   # search data roles can take 5-10 minutes
python -m hrrag.evaluate --search-endpoint $env:SEARCH --mode vector | Out-Null   # proves vectorizer and managed identity role

steps: Open the search service in rg-mglab-ai-03 > Indexes > hr-handbook
Show the document count (25) and the vector index size
Optional: Keys page showing 'Role-based access control' selected (API keys disabled); never open key values
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: answer
commands: python -m hrrag.answer "If I don't use all my vacation this year, can I keep some days?" --search-endpoint $env:SEARCH --aoai-endpoint $env:AOAI

screens.name: not-found
commands: python -m hrrag.answer "What is the company car policy?" --search-endpoint $env:SEARCH --aoai-endpoint $env:AOAI

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-3 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
